title: The Understudy WIP
description: Work-in-progress build of The Understudy, a new playable character for Slay the Spire 2. Shared for friend testing. Requires BaseLib.
changeNote: v1.13.63: Reworded the Swap keyword ("Trade the rightmost swappable debuff of yours for the rightmost swappable buff from each enemy"), and added a new "Swap & Invert" keyword explaining the simultaneous trade-and-keep-the-buff behavior. Best of Both, Pass the Mic, Standing Ovation (and Glitter Bomb) now show all three keywords: Swap, Invert, and Swap & Invert.
